result.summary: Several layout and overflow issues: category chips and restaurant cards are clipped at the screen edges, and restaurant names are truncated.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge (image and name 'Trattoria Piccol' are clipped).
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right padding/margin to the horizontal list or show a peek of the next card so content is not cropped.

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow the screen: 'Healthy' is clipped and a partial next chip is visible with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding and a fade/scroll indicator so chips aren’t cut off at the viewport edge.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is truncated to 'Tokumaru Ramer' under the featured card.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap or use a slightly smaller font so the full name is visible.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is cropped by the tab bar, so only part of the image and the discount badge are visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset so the last card can scroll fully above the tab bar.
